title: Neoproterozoic (Ediacaran) oxygenation
summary: During the Ediacaran Period, roughly 635 to 541 million years ago, oxygen in the air and oceans appears to have risen. Evidence shows pulses around 580 million years ago, and one model suggests a sustained increase to about a quarter of todays level. Whether it was one event or a fluctuating window is debated.

uncertainty.note: Start is the c. 580 Ma pulse reported from the Oman Shuram Excursion work; the Ediacaran rise modelled by Williams and colleagues spans the whole period, 635 to 541 Ma, so the start could be as early as 635 Ma. End is the end of the Ediacaran, 541 Ma.
